name: Storm Lead
pitch: Morning-after alerts for Michigan roofing/restoration contractors listing ZIPs hit by hail 1in+ or damaging wind, $50-100/month. Sources: NOAA SPC storm reports, NWS alerts, OpenFEMA. G0 includes a 24-month Michigan backtest of alert frequency.
